Abdul Fatawu.note: Watch Fatawu for explosive speed once open grass appears. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Abdul Fatawu.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是看到空当后的爆发速度。留意他如何提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Abdul Mumin.note: Watch Mumin for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Abdul Mumin.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。留意他如何等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Baba Rahman.note: Baba stands out for making the safer decision before a duel becomes an emergency. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Baba Rahman.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择。他会传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Jonas Adjetey.note: Adjetey stands out for using strength without slowing the next action. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Jonas Adjetey.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在对抗中用力量但不拖慢下一步。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。

Prince Adu.note: Adu's edge is starting his run while defenders are still watching the ball. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Prince Adu.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在防守者仍盯着球时提前启动。他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Alidu Seidu.note: Watch Seidu for recovery speed when the defensive line is exposed. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Alidu Seidu.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是防线暴露后的回追速度。留意他如何守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。

Joseph Anang.note: Anang stands out for sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders.
Joseph Anang.noteZh: 他的突出特点是提前站位后的快速反应。他会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。他也会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Antoine Semenyo.note: Semenyo's signature is using strength without slowing the next action. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Antoine Semenyo.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在对抗中用力量但不拖慢下一步上。他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Brandon Thomas-Asante.note: Thomas-Asante is defined by pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet.
Brandon Thomas-Asante.noteZh: 他靠带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑与同位置球员拉开差异。他会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。他也会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。

Benjamin Asare.note: Watch Asare for sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders. He varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Benjamin Asare.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是提前站位后的快速反应。留意他如何判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Augustine Boakye.note: Boakye stands out for changing direction without losing control of the ball. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him.
Augustine Boakye.noteZh: 他的突出特点是变向时仍把球控制在脚下。他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。他也会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。

Christopher Bonsu Baah.note: Baah stands out for explosive speed once open grass appears. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target.
Christopher Bonsu Baah.noteZh: 他的突出特点是看到空当后的爆发速度。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。

Caleb Yirenkyi.note: Yirenkyi is defined by creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Caleb Yirenkyi.noteZh: 他靠在防线重组前制造干净射门与同位置球员拉开差异。他会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。他也会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Derrick Luckassen.note: Watch Luckassen for creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He recognizes when to slow the play and when to take the risk. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Derrick Luckassen.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在防线重组前制造干净射门。留意他如何判断何时放慢节奏，何时承担风险。他也会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Elisha Owusu.note: Owusu is defined by choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Elisha Owusu.noteZh: 他靠选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢与同位置球员拉开差异。他会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Ernest Nuamah.note: Nuamah is defined by seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Ernest Nuamah.noteZh: 他靠比防线早一步看到决定性的传球与同位置球员拉开差异。他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Gideon Mensah.note: Mensah stands out for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Gideon Mensah.noteZh: 他的突出特点是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Inaki Williams.note: Williams stands out for explosive speed once open grass appears. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Inaki Williams.noteZh: 他的突出特点是看到空当后的爆发速度。他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Jordan Ayew.note: Ayew stands out for making purposeful movement away from the ball. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path. He varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Jordan Ayew.noteZh: 他的突出特点是用有目的的无球移动创造接应点。他会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Jerome Opoku.note: Opoku stands out for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Jerome Opoku.noteZh: 他的突出特点是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。他也会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Kamaldeen Sulemana.note: Watch Sulemana for changing direction without losing control of the ball. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track.
Kamaldeen Sulemana.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是变向时仍把球控制在脚下。留意他如何等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。他也会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。

Kojo Peprah Oppong.note: Oppong is defined by moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Kojo Peprah Oppong.noteZh: 他靠用传球的力度和角度移动防线与同位置球员拉开差异。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Kwasi Sibo.note: Watch Sibo for creating a better angle for the next pass. He positions himself for the next touch before the first contest is over. He holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives.
Kwasi Sibo.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是为下一脚传球制造更好的角度。留意他如何第一次争抢还没结束，就先为下一脚触球站好位置。他也会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Lawrence Ati-Zigi.note: Ati-Zigi's signature is staying ready through long quiet spells. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Lawrence Ati-Zigi.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在长时间无事可做后依然保持专注上。他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Marvin Senaya.note: Watch Senaya for recovering position without panicking after the first line is broken. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Marvin Senaya.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是第一道防线被突破后仍能冷静回位。留意他如何等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Thomas Partey.note: Partey's signature is keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Thomas Partey.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定上。他会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。
